Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
9:20 PM

The National Museum in New Delhi (Janpath) is open Tue to Sun, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and closed on Mondays and national holidays. Tickets are ₹20 for adults and ₹500 for foreign nationals. Students up to class 12 get in free with their I-cards.

The official page also has a notice from 29 May 2023 saying the Arms and Armour, Textiles and Jewellery galleries are closed for renovation until further notice. It may be out of date, so check before you go if those galleries matter to you.

Tomorrow, Fri 13 Nov, the museum should be open as usual, unless it is a national holiday.
